clips.notes: calm and steady: slow breathing with one deeper breath, small weight shift with the hips leading, hands loosely together in front, looks at his partner, glances away and back (neck leads), a small content nod; ponytail and sash settle after each move; blinks single / double / slow
calm, even walk (~106 steps/min): soft hip bob, chest counter-turn, relaxed arm swing with lagging forearms, head steady; ponytail and the sash ends swing late

warm, unhurried talking: jaw in an irregular syllable rhythm with word gaps (lip sync overrides it), nods on the stressed syllables; phrase 1 the right hand opens palm-up toward the listener, phrase 2 the left hand comes to his chest; small weight shift; two blinks

a breath, the right hand comes to his chest, bows from the hips (chest and head follow late, ponytail swings forward), holds a beat, comes half way up and stays: a respectful half-bow with the hand on his heart

faces the window (or the viewer in the den): a breath, kneels right knee then left (knees on the page), settles back, raises both hands a little in front of his chest, palms up, bows his head and closes his eyes; holds (eyes closed, still). pet_lion and stand_up start from the same kneel
from the kneel (kneel_pray / pet_lion): opens his eyes and looks up, sets the left foot forward, pushes up with a hand on the knee, rises, brings the feet together, settles calm; holds standing

sure and gentle ("don't worry"): a small breath, one slow deep nod with a slight head tilt, the right hand opens a little toward the listener, eyes close softly on the nod; settles back to the idle stance

kneeling (same kneel as kneel_pray), leaning forward; the right hand strokes the lion's mane 0.12 in front at the lying lion's mane height (0.07): two long strokes per loop (hand on, slide, lift, back), the left hand rests on his thigh, head tilted down toward the lion, smiling, slow blinks
happy, looking up at someone above (the king at the den's opening): chin up, the right arm high waving from the elbow, the left hand up at shoulder height too, little bounces on his toes

hugs the king standing 0.11 in front: steps in, both arms round the king's waist (under the cape), cheek against the king's chest, head turned to his right, eyes closed; rocking side to side in phase with king_hug (start them on the same frame); one squeeze
friendly goodbye to the viewer: the right hand up beside the head waving from the elbow, the left hand relaxed, a smile with a small head tilt and a weight shift

content and regal: both hands on his round belly (two little pats with a belly jiggle), slow breathing that lifts the belly, weight shifts L -> R, looks round his court and back, a pleased chin-up, blinks
slow, heavy, sad walk: head low, shoulders slumped, arms hanging, short dragging steps with a heavy drop on each, cape swaying late, a sigh in the chest
the king speaks: jaw in a syllable rhythm with word gaps, the left hand stays on his belly, the right hand makes broad regal gestures on the stressed words, chin up, weight shift
delighted: arms open wide with palms up, chuckling between words (shoulder and belly bounces in uneven pulses), head tipping back on the laughs, jaw talking; the belly jiggles late
pleased with himself: chin up, chest out, hands on his hips (elbows out), sways slowly side to side rocking heel to toe, eyes half closed

seals the law: the right fist (signet ring) rises with a little flourish, then presses firmly down onto something at his chest height in front of him (marker `stamp` = contact), holds a beat, lifts and settles with a satisfied nod; ends with both hands on his belly (idle)
fretting: both hands pressed to his cheeks, rocking side to side, small fast head shakes, quick nervous blinks, belly wobbles

IN PLACE (the director does not move him): hands clasped behind his back, he walks three slow steps to his left, turns round, three back and turns again - a real small path of about 0.07 about the root, the planted feet stay still; head down in thought, a sigh at each turn. Cape lifted a little off the hands
despair: a breath, his hands come up to his face and the head sinks into them, shoulders slump forward, one big sobbing sigh, holds slumped (still)
pleading toward Daniel: a little step forward on the left foot, leans in, both hands reach out in front at chest height, palms up and open; holds reaching

sleepless: sits on the dais step behind him (seat 0.027 high, 0.078 behind the root), elbows on knees, chin in hands, a long sigh (shoulders lift and drop), flops back, gets up restless, turns his head about, sits down again with a bump (belly jiggle). Loops on the seated pose

checks.note: robe / cape below the step tops are inside the dais (hidden); only the front of the dais counts

clips.notes: hurried royal waddle-run: short quick steps with a side-to-side waddle, leaning forward, arms pumping with flapping hands, belly bouncing on every step, the cape flying out behind
calling into the den: hands cupped round his mouth, leaning toward the den on tiptoe, two calls per loop (jaw wide, body pumps forward on each call), listening tilt between them
pure joy: crouches, hops straight up with both arms flung high, belly bouncing, lands with a squash and a belly jiggle, settles with arms open

hugs Daniel standing 0.11 in front (shorter than him): leans over him, both arms wrapped round Daniel's back at the shoulder blades, cheek on top of Daniel's head, eyes closed and smiling; rocking in phase with daniel_hug (start them on the same frame), one big squeeze with a belly jiggle

the decree, booming: left arm raised high (open hand), the right hand on Daniel's near shoulder (Daniel standing to his right, about 0.14 away and a little in front, as in S12), chin up, chest out, jaw in a big slow syllable rhythm, emphatic downward beats of the raised hand
shifty: shoulders up, fingertips together in front, eyes and head dart left - right - left with quick turns and frozen holds, little fidgeting finger taps, weight shifting, a sniff; blinks
prim, busy walk: quick steps, nose up, shoulders stiff, elbows in with the forearms swinging, the robe hem swinging late
whiny, wheedling talk: jaw in a quick syllable rhythm, a wagging index hand on the stressed words, the other hand on his chest, head bobbing and tilting, shoulders up
sulky: a huff (shoulders up and down), folds his arms tight across his chest, chin up, turns his head away with eyes half closed, weight onto one leg with the other knee bent; holds
angry stamping walk: high knee lifts, each foot slammed down flat (the body jolts on impact), fists clenched and pumping stiffly, head jutting forward, robe hem flapping
grumbling to the viewer: both fists up in front of his chest shaking with fury, muttering jaw, then one foot stamp (body jolts), fists shake again; scowl

sly idea: rubs his chin thinking (eyes up), then "aha!" - the right hand pops up beside his face, fingers up (single-bone fingers: open hand, palm forward), head tilts with a sly grin, the other hand on his hip; holds
scheming glee: hunched, hands rubbing together quickly in front of his chest, shoulders up, giggling head bobs

oily flattery to the king: two deep bows per loop from the hips with a sweeping left-hand flourish (a circle out and down to the side), the right hand holding the law scroll against his chest; comes up with a big fake grin and a head tilt between the bows (officer/scroll shown)

exaggerated cartoon tiptoe: on the tips of his curly slippers, knees lifted high and placed carefully, hunched forward, both hands held up at his chest like little paws, head low and turning to peek about

spying from behind the palm: leans far out sideways to his left (hips and spine), the head pokes out and turns toward the target, rubs his hands in glee while out, then ducks back to cover and peeks again
accusing: "aha!" - leans in and thrusts the right arm straight out at Daniel (open hand, fingers straight - single-bone fingers), the left hand on his hip, chin jutting; holds pointing
cartoon fright: jumps straight up off both feet, legs cycling in the air (two quick running circles), arms flung up and wiggling, hair-raising stretch; lands in a low crouch already leaning to run
panicked cartoon run: fast high-kneed strides, body leaning forward, both arms flailing wildly over his head, head thrown back yelling (jaw open), robe hem flapping

sitting like a big cat: rump on the page, front legs straight, hind feet flat, tail round his left side; slow breathing, looks about with curious head tilts, the tail tip flicks twice, ears twitch, blinks (single, double, slow)

sitting like a big cat: rump on the page, front legs straight, hind feet flat, tail round his left side; slow breathing, looks about with curious head tilts, the tail tip flicks twice, ears twitch, blinks (single, double, slow)

asleep, lying curled on the belly: body in a C toward its left, chin on the left paw, tail curled round the front; slow deep breathing (3 s), a little snore in the jaw, one ear twitch, a tail-tip twitch, eyes closed

asleep, lying curled on the belly: body in a C toward its left, chin on the left paw, tail curled round the front; slow deep breathing (3 s), a little snore in the jaw, one ear twitch, a tail-tip twitch, eyes closed

from sleep: an ear twitches, the head lifts, sleepy half-open eyes and a slow blink, a little head shake, front legs push up, then the rump, straightens the tail; ends standing on all fours (blends into roar / growl / prowl)

from sleep: an ear twitches, the head lifts, sleepy half-open eyes and a slow blink, a little head shake, front legs push up, then the rump, straightens the tail; ends standing on all fours (blends into roar / growl / prowl)

the big roar (warm, not scary): draws the head back and down, then rears it up and forward with the jaw wide (28 deg), the mane shaking, chest up, tail up stiff, paws planted; closes the mouth with a little head shake and a proud huff; ends standing

the big roar (warm, not scary): draws the head back and down, then rears it up and forward with the jaw wide (28 deg), the mane shaking, chest up, tail up stiff, paws planted; closes the mouth with a little head shake and a proud huff; ends standing

a low warning growl: head lowered and forward, shoulders hunched, the lip curls (jaw trembles a little open), weight rocks slowly side to side and each front paw lifts and is set down again on the same spot, tail low and swishing

a low warning growl: head lowered and forward, shoulders hunched, the lip curls (jaw trembles a little open), weight rocks slowly side to side and each front paw lifts and is set down again on the same spot, tail low and swishing
relaxed cat walk, lateral four-beat sequence (left hind, left fore, right hind, right fore): soft shoulder and hip roll, head steady with a small nod, tail swaying late; paws planted in stance
relaxed cat walk, lateral four-beat sequence (left hind, left fore, right hind, right fore): soft shoulder and hip roll, head steady with a small nod, tail swaying late; paws planted in stance
slow stalking prowl: body low, head low and forward, shoulder blades rolling, each paw lifted high and placed carefully, a slow swish of the low tail, eyes fixed ahead
slow stalking prowl: body low, head low and forward, shoulder blades rolling, each paw lifted high and placed carefully, a slow swish of the low tail, eyes fixed ahead

lazy and funny: a long cat stretch (front paws walk forward, chest down, rump up, eyes shut), back up, sits down, then a HUGE yawn (head up, jaw wide 36 deg, ears back, eyes squeezed), a lip smack and a content blink; ends sitting (= idle frame 0)

lazy and funny: a long cat stretch (front paws walk forward, chest down, rump up, eyes shut), back up, sits down, then a HUGE yawn (head up, jaw wide 36 deg, ears back, eyes squeezed), a lip smack and a content blink; ends sitting (= idle frame 0)
settles down for a rest: the front legs fold first (chest sinks), then the rump, front paws forward, head lowered onto the paws with a happy sigh, tail curled along the side; holds lying (blissful)
settles down for a rest: the front legs fold first (chest sinks), then the rump, front paws forward, head lowered onto the paws with a happy sigh, tail curled along the side; holds lying (blissful)

the comic high point: from sitting, flops down onto its side and rolls onto its back - belly up, paws folded in the air, head tipped back toward Daniel with a blissful smile; then wriggles happily on its back (scratching it on the floor), paws kneading the air, tail wagging; frames 70..150 loop seamlessly
